# situation: permissions: write-all is written at the top of the workflow,
#   and the job runs actions/checkout, actions/setup-node and npm ci.
# reason: write-all gives the job's token write on every scope; both actions
#   take it as the default of their token input, and actions/checkout leaves
#   it in .git/config, where the install scripts of the packages npm ci
#   installs can read it.
# attack: the maintainer of a package npm ci installs, or whoever takes over
#   their account, publishes a version whose install script reads the token
#   and sends it out.
# attack-run-behavior: actions/checkout writes the token into .git/config
#   as an extraheader; npm ci runs the package's install script, which reads
#   it there, and the token it sends writes every scope until the job ends.
on: workflow_call
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      - run: npm ci && npm test
